facts.business: A2Z Infra Engineering Ltd. operates in Engineering services, Facility Management Services (FMS), and Municipal Solid Waste Management, providing EPC solutions in Telecom and Power Transmission & Distribution.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company remains committed to the continuous reduction of its debt through prudent financial management, improved operational performance, and constructive engagement with its lending partners.

The Company will continue to pursue a balanced and prudent growth strategy, with emphasis on financial discipline, operational efficiency, selective project acquisition and sustainable value creation for its stakeholders.
